verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const a="app/(main)/circles/actions.ts",l="app/(main)/circles/[slug]/(circle)/layout.tsx";if(!fs.existsSync(a)||!fs.existsSync(l))process.exit(79);const s=fs.readFileSync(a,"utf8");const i=s.indexOf("export async function joinCircle");if(i<0)process.exit(79);const j=s.indexOf("\nexport ",i+10);const body=s.slice(i,j<0?s.length:j);const sel=body.match(/\.from\(.circles.\)[\s\S]*?\.select\(([^)]*)\)/);const noStatus=!sel||!/status/.test(sel[1])||!/LISTABLE_CIRCLE_STATUS|\.status/.test(body);const layoutJoin=/canJoin\s*=\s*!isMember\s*&&\s*!!myProfileId\s*&&\s*!full\s*&&\s*!isDraft\b/.test(fs.readFileSync(l,"utf8"));if(noStatus||layoutJoin){console.error("SCAN-691: joinCircle still never reads or checks the circle status, or the layout still offers Join on any non-draft circle, so an inactive, draft or archived circle accepts joins.");process.exit(1)}'

append.detail: joinCircle (app/(main)/circles/actions.ts) read member_count, cap, hub, access and the visibility axes but never status, and the insert runs through the admin client, so an inactive, draft or archived circle could be joined by id (stale QR, direct action call), and the detail layout computed canJoin from isDraft alone so a switched-off circle still showed a live Join. Fix: joinCircle now selects status and, right after the missing-row check, refuses any status outside LISTABLE_CIRCLE_STATUS with the same 'This circle is no longer available.' copy (fails closed on a missing status); the layout computes canJoin from LISTABLE_CIRCLE_STATUS.includes(circle.status), which also covers drafts. Pinned in app/(main)/circles/join-privacy.test.ts: inactive, draft and archived are refused with the missing-circle copy and write no membership row, an invite does not open a draft, a missing status is refused, forming and active still join.
